name: The farm
line: Your land, with the house, the barn and the fields.

line: Trees, forage and a lake west of the farm.

line: Rock, ore and a lake high above the valley.

name: The delta
line: Marsh and river mouth, good for fish and wild plants.

name: The green
line: The open ground at the middle of the village.

name: Hearthwell
line: The hearth town beyond the green.

name: The village hall
line: Where the bundles are handed in.

name: The mines
line: Floors of rock, ore and creatures.

name: The quarry
line: Broken stone, and the rocks that come from it.

line: A waystation at the edge of the home valley.

name: The lake cove
line: A quiet cove on the lake.

name: The Secret Woods
line: A hidden wood behind the Forest.

name: The hedge maze
line: A maze of hedges, open on festival days.
